blocks.zh: 文件要求
blocks.en: Documentation Requirements

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 HVAC 工程文件的生命週期（Life Cycle，生命週期）：從概念設計到竣工圖（As-built Drawing，竣工圖）再到主文件（Master Document，主文件）的演進過程
blocks.en: Understand the life cycle of HVAC engineering documents: the progression from conceptual design to as-built drawings and then to master documents

blocks.zh: 區分三類 HVAC 文件：維護/營運文件（Non-GMP）、主文件/記錄文件（Record Document，記錄文件）、以及 GMP 文件（GMP Document，GMP 文件）
blocks.en: Distinguish the three categories of HVAC documents: maintenance/operations documents (non-GMP), master/record documents, and GMP documents

blocks.zh: 掌握 Engineering Turnover Package（ETOP，工程移交文件包）的內容與建置時機
blocks.en: Know the content of the Engineering Turnover Package (ETOP) and when to build it

blocks.zh: 理解 Critical Master Document（關鍵主文件）的定義、維護標準及其在 CMC 申報中的角色
blocks.en: Understand the definition of a Critical Master Document, the standard for maintaining it, and its role in CMC filings

blocks.zh: 熟悉試車確效（Commissioning & Qualification）與製程驗證（Process Validation）階段所需的 HVAC 文件清單
blocks.en: Be familiar with the HVAC document lists required in the Commissioning & Qualification and Process Validation phases

blocks.zh: 6.1 Introduction 6.1 簡介
blocks.en: 6.1 Introduction

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：HVAC 文件的雙重身分
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Dual Identity of HVAC Documents

blocks.zh: HVAC 文件不只是工程資料，更可能是 GMP 記錄。
blocks.en: HVAC documents are not just engineering data; they may also be GMP records.

blocks.zh: 確效完成後，HVAC 系統的文件需要被「分類」——哪些留給維護團隊參考用，哪些要升格為 GMP 記錄文件，甚至成為 CMC 申報的一部分。
blocks.en: Once qualification is complete, the HVAC system documents need to be "classified": which ones stay with the maintenance team for reference, which ones are upgraded to GMP record documents, and which ones become part of the CMC filing.

blocks.zh: CMC（Chemistry Manufacturing Controls）：藥品上市申請中描述製造與品管方法的章節。HVAC 相關的環境分類圖（Area Classification）、管儀圖（P&ID，管儀圖）等，都可能被納入 CMC 申報。
blocks.en: CMC (Chemistry, Manufacturing and Controls): the section of a marketing application that describes the manufacturing and quality control methods. HVAC-related items such as the area classification drawing and the P&ID (piping and instrumentation diagram) may be included in the CMC filing.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：房屋買賣的文件分級
blocks.en: Analogy: Document Tiers When Buying a House

blocks.zh: 買一棟房子時，會有各種文件：建築設計圖、水電配線圖、裝潢合約、驗屋報告、房屋所有權狀。
blocks.en: When you buy a house, you receive many documents: architectural drawings, electrical and plumbing diagrams, the renovation contract, the inspection report and the property title.

blocks.zh: 有些文件只在裝修時有用（如裝潢合約），有些需要長期保管（如所有權狀），有些在轉賣時必須出示（如驗屋報告）。
blocks.en: Some are useful only during renovation (such as the renovation contract), some must be kept long term (such as the title), and some must be shown when you resell (such as the inspection report).

blocks.zh: HVAC 文件也一樣——施工圖紙完成使命後可以歸檔，但竣工圖和環境分級圖必須隨時保持最新狀態，因為稽查員隨時可能要求查看。
blocks.en: HVAC documents work the same way. Construction drawings can be archived once they have served their purpose, but the as-built drawings and the area classification drawing must always be kept current, because an inspector may ask to see them at any time.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：文件分類的時機
blocks.en: Key Point: When to Classify Documents

blocks.zh: 本節開宗明義指出，文件分類應在「確效完成後」確立。但實務上，越早規劃文件分類越好——最佳時機是在概念設計階段就定義哪些文件將成為 GMP 記錄。等到確效完成才決定，往往發現許多資料已經遺失或格式不符。
blocks.en: This section states clearly that document classification should be established "after qualification is complete". In practice, however, the earlier you plan the classification, the better. The best time is the conceptual design stage, when you define which documents will become GMP records. If you wait until qualification is complete to decide, you often find that much of the data has been lost or is in the wrong format.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 如果你是 CDMO 的工程主管，剛完成一條新的無菌充填線 HVAC 系統確效，你會如何決定哪些文件歸維護部門、哪些升格為 GMP 記錄？判斷標準是什麼？
blocks.en: If you are the engineering manager at a CDMO and have just completed HVAC qualification for a new aseptic filling line, how would you decide which documents go to the maintenance department and which are upgraded to GMP records? What criteria would you use?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 CMC 申報需要包含 HVAC 相關文件？這與產品品質有什麼直接關聯？
blocks.en: Why must a CMC filing include HVAC-related documents? How is this directly linked to product quality?

blocks.zh: 6.2 Engineering Document Life Cycle 6.2 工程文件生命週期
blocks.en: 6.2 Engineering Document Life Cycle

blocks.zh: 6.2.1 Planning Life Cycle 6.2.1 規劃生命週期
blocks.en: 6.2.1 Planning Life Cycle

blocks.zh: 核心概念：文件生命週期規劃
blocks.en: Core Concept: Planning the Document Life Cycle

blocks.zh: Life Cycle（生命週期）：文件從產生到歸檔、維護、最終廢止的完整過程。ISPE 強調，文件的「命運」必須在專案最早期就決定。
blocks.en: Life Cycle: the complete process of a document from creation through archiving and maintenance to eventual retirement. ISPE stresses that the "fate" of each document must be decided at the very start of the project.

blocks.zh: ETOP（Engineering Turnover Package，工程移交文件包）：施工完成後，從工程團隊正式移交給營運/維護團隊的文件包。內容涵蓋設計依據、竣工圖、設備手冊等。
blocks.en: ETOP (Engineering Turnover Package): the document package formally handed over from the engineering team to the operations/maintenance team after construction is complete. It covers the design basis, as-built drawings, equipment manuals and so on.

blocks.zh: Traceability Matrix（追溯矩陣）：一份追蹤文件，串聯「使用者需求 → 功能設計 → 施工 → 確效 → 製程驗證」的完整鏈條，確保每個設計意圖都能被追溯到最終驗證結果。
blocks.en: Traceability Matrix: a tracking document that links the full chain of "user requirements → functional design → construction → qualification → process validation", ensuring that every design intent can be traced to its final verification result.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：蓋房子前先決定保固資料
blocks.en: Analogy: Deciding the Warranty Records Before Building the House

blocks.zh: 想像你要蓋一棟自住的房子。聰明的做法是在動工之前就決定：哪些文件要給裝修公司存檔、哪些要自己保管做日後維修用、哪些要送政府備查。
blocks.en: Imagine you are building a house to live in. The smart approach is to decide before work begins which documents go to the contractor for filing, which you keep for future repairs, and which are submitted to the authorities.

blocks.zh: 如果等到蓋好才回頭找文件，會發現設計師的計算書找不到了、水電配管圖沒有更新、結構計算書還是初版。ISPE 建議在「概念設計」甚至「功能設計」階段就決定每份文件的歸宿，正是同樣的道理。
blocks.en: If you wait until the house is finished to look for documents, you will find that the designer's calculations are missing, the plumbing and electrical drawings were never updated, and the structural calculations are still the first version. This is exactly why ISPE recommends deciding the destination of each document at the conceptual design or even the functional design stage.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：追溯矩陣的稽查價值
blocks.en: Key Point: The Audit Value of the Traceability Matrix

blocks.zh: Traceability Matrix 不只是專案管理工具，更是法規稽查的防禦武器。FDA 稽查員經常會問：「你的確效方案是基於什麼設計依據？設計依據又回應了什麼使用者需求？」
blocks.en: The Traceability Matrix is not just a project management tool; it is also a defensive weapon in regulatory inspections. FDA inspectors often ask: "What design basis is your qualification protocol based on? What user requirement does that design basis answer?"

blocks.zh: 追溯矩陣讓你能一步步反推：確效結果 → 測試方案 → 設計規格 → 使用者需求。這條「可追溯鏈」完整，稽查就不會有疑慮。
blocks.en: The traceability matrix lets you work backward step by step: qualification results → test protocol → design specification → user requirements. When this "traceable chain" is complete, the inspection will not raise concerns.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：CDMO 的 ETOP 最佳實踐
blocks.en: Practical Application: ETOP Best Practices for a CDMO

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，客戶經常在專案完成後才進行技術轉移稽查。此時如果 ETOP 不完整，會造成極大的溝通成本。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, clients often conduct technology transfer audits after a project is completed. If the ETOP is incomplete at that point, it creates a great deal of communication overhead.

blocks.zh: 時機：在 P&ID 審查會議時，同步規劃 ETOP 內容清單
blocks.en: Timing: Plan the ETOP content list at the P&ID review meeting

blocks.zh: 工具：使用文件管理系統（如 MasterControl、Veeva）自動套用文件生命週期
blocks.en: Tools: Use a document management system (such as MasterControl or Veeva) to apply the document life cycle automatically

blocks.zh: 人員：指定一位「文件協調員」負責追蹤每份文件的狀態
blocks.en: People: Appoint a "document coordinator" to track the status of each document

blocks.zh: 如果你的專案到了施工階段才開始規劃 ETOP 內容，可能會遇到什麼問題？舉一個具體的例子。
blocks.en: If you only start planning the ETOP content once your project reaches the construction phase, what problems might you run into? Give a specific example.

blocks.zh: Traceability Matrix 和確效方案（Validation Protocol）有什麼關係？兩者可以整合成一份文件嗎？
blocks.en: What is the relationship between the Traceability Matrix and the Validation Protocol? Can the two be combined into one document?

blocks.zh: 6.2.2 Typical Steps in the Document Life Cycle 6.2.2 文件生命週期典型步驟
blocks.en: 6.2.2 Typical Steps in the Document Life Cycle

blocks.zh: 核心概念：文件的三階段演進
blocks.en: Core Concept: Three Stages of Document Evolution

blocks.zh: HVAC 文件的生命週期可以分為三個明確的階段：
blocks.en: The HVAC document life cycle can be divided into three distinct stages:

blocks.zh: 概念文件（Conceptual）：AFD（Air Flow Diagram，氣流圖）、AF&ID（Air Flow & Instrument Diagram，氣流與儀錶圖）、房間條件表等。這些是設計初期的藍圖。
blocks.en: Conceptual: AFD (Air Flow Diagram), AF&ID (Air Flow & Instrument Diagram), room condition tables and so on. These are the blueprints of the early design phase.

blocks.zh: 施工文件（Construction）：詳細計算書、平面圖、施工圖、規格書。這些是實際建造的依據。
blocks.en: Construction: detailed calculations, plan drawings, construction drawings and specifications. These are the basis for the actual build.

blocks.zh: 竣工/主文件（As-built / Master）：施工完成後更新為「竣工狀態」，反映實際安裝情況。關鍵文件進一步升格為「主文件」或「關鍵主文件」。
blocks.en: As-built / Master: after construction is complete, documents are updated to "as-built" status to reflect the actual installation. Key documents are then upgraded to "Master Documents" or "Critical Master Documents".

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：文件演進如同建築竣工驗收
blocks.en: Analogy: Document Evolution Is Like a Building Completion Inspection

blocks.zh: 建築師畫的設計圖（概念文件）是理想狀態。施工過程中，因為現場條件限制，管線走向可能會微調、設備位置可能會偏移。
blocks.en: The architect's design drawings (conceptual documents) represent the ideal state. During construction, because of site constraints, pipe routing may be adjusted slightly and equipment locations may shift.

blocks.zh: 竣工圖（As-built Drawing，竣工圖）就像 Google Maps 的「實景圖」——不是設計師畫的理想路線，而是實際蓋好後的真實配置。
blocks.en: As-built drawings are like the "street view" in Google Maps: not the ideal route the designer drew, but the real layout after the building was completed.

blocks.zh: 如果你拿著「設計圖」去找管線，可能會在錯誤的位置打洞。這就是為什麼 ISPE 強調「as-built 更新」對維護至關重要。
blocks.en: If you look for pipework using the "design drawing", you may drill in the wrong place. This is why ISPE emphasizes that "as-built updates" are essential for maintenance.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：主文件 vs. 關鍵主文件
blocks.en: Key Point: Master Document vs. Critical Master Document

blocks.zh: 本節定義了兩種「主文件」層級：
blocks.en: This section defines two levels of "master document":

blocks.zh: Master Document（主文件）：移除施工註記後的工程文件，作為系統持續狀態的記錄。
blocks.en: Master Document: an engineering document with construction markups removed, serving as a record of the ongoing state of the system.

blocks.zh: Critical Master Document（關鍵主文件）：定義 HVAC 系統關鍵屬性的主文件，必須隨時保持在「可接受稽查」的狀態。
blocks.en: Critical Master Document: a master document that defines the critical attributes of the HVAC system and must be kept in a constant state of inspection readiness.

blocks.zh: 「constant state of inspection readiness」（隨時可接受稽查）是關鍵字——意味著這些文件不能等到稽查通知後才更新，而是每次變更後都必須立即更新。
blocks.en: "Constant state of inspection readiness" is the key phrase: these documents cannot wait to be updated until an inspection is announced, but must be updated immediately after every change.

blocks.zh: ISPE 明確指出，至少 AF&ID、HVAC 分區佈局圖和區域分級圖必須保持在最新狀態。
blocks.en: ISPE states explicitly that, at a minimum, the AF&ID, the HVAC zoning layout and the area classification drawing must be kept up to date.

blocks.zh: 文件演進流程圖
blocks.en: Document Evolution Flow Chart

blocks.zh:
概念文件 (AFD, AF&ID, 房間條件表)
    |
    v  工程設計階段
施工文件 (計算書, 施工圖, 規格書)
    |
    v  施工完成 → 竣工更新
竣工文件 (As-built Drawings)
    |
    +--→ 維護用文件 (ETOP)
    |
    +--→ 主文件 (Master Documents)
    |         |
    |         +--→ 關鍵主文件 (Critical Master Documents)
    |                   ↑ 隨時可接受稽查
    |
    +--→ 確效文件 (Qualification Documents)
blocks.en:
Conceptual documents (AFD, AF&ID, room condition tables)
    |
    v  Engineering design phase
Construction documents (calculations, construction drawings, specifications)
    |
    v  Construction complete → as-built update
As-built documents (As-built Drawings)
    |
    +--→ Maintenance documents (ETOP)
    |
    +--→ Master Documents
    |         |
    |         +--→ Critical Master Documents
    |                   ↑ Constant state of inspection readiness
    |
    +--→ Qualification Documents

blocks.zh: 一份 HVAC 系統的 AF&ID 在施工後發現需要增加一個 HEPA 過濾器。這份文件需要經歷哪些步驟才能正確更新為關鍵主文件？
blocks.en: After construction, it is found that the AF&ID of an HVAC system needs an additional HEPA filter. What steps must this document go through to be correctly updated as a Critical Master Document?

blocks.zh: 如果某份設計計算書在施工階段被設備廠商的送審資料取代了，這份原始計算書還需要保留嗎？為什麼？
blocks.en: If a design calculation was replaced during construction by the equipment vendor's submittal data, does the original calculation still need to be retained? Why?

blocks.zh: 6.3 Documents for Maintenance and Operations (Non-GMP) 6.3 維護與營運文件（非 GMP）
blocks.en: 6.3 Documents for Maintenance and Operations (Non-GMP)

blocks.zh: 核心概念：ETOP 的定位與價值
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Role and Value of the ETOP

blocks.zh: ETOP（Engineering Turnover Package，工程移交文件包）是施工團隊移交給營運/維護團隊的核心文件集。它的設計原則是「精簡但完整」。
blocks.en: ETOP (Engineering Turnover Package) is the core document set that the construction team hands over to the operations/maintenance team. Its design principle is "lean but complete".

blocks.zh: 注意：ETOP 中的文件不一定都是 GMP 文件。本節特別標註「Non-GMP」，意味著這些文件主要服務於維護和營運需求，而非法規合規目的。
blocks.en: Note: documents in the ETOP are not necessarily all GMP documents. This section is specifically labelled "Non-GMP", meaning these documents mainly serve maintenance and operational needs rather than regulatory compliance.

blocks.zh: CMMS（Computerized Maintenance Management System，電腦化維護管理系統）：用於管理預防性維護排程、工單追蹤、備品庫存的系統。ETOP 中的設備資料是建立 CMMS 資料庫的基礎。
blocks.en: CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System): a system used to manage preventive maintenance schedules, work order tracking and spare parts inventory. The equipment data in the ETOP is the basis for building the CMMS database.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：新車交車時的資料袋
blocks.en: Analogy: The Document Pack When You Collect a New Car

blocks.zh: 買新車時，車商會給你一個「交車資料袋」：車主手冊、保養排程、保固卡、緊急救援電話、輪胎規格表。
blocks.en: When you buy a new car, the dealer gives you a handover pack: owner's manual, maintenance schedule, warranty card, emergency roadside assistance number and tire specification sheet.

blocks.zh: 你不需要整本設計工程圖——那些是給原廠工程師用的。你需要的是日常使用和維護所需的精華資訊。
blocks.en: You do not need the full engineering drawings; those are for the manufacturer's engineers. What you need is the essential information for daily use and maintenance.

blocks.zh: ETOP 就是 HVAC 系統的「交車資料袋」。給維護團隊的不是上百頁的設計文件，而是他們真正需要的竣工圖、設備參數、控制邏輯和測試記錄。
blocks.en: The ETOP is the "handover pack" of the HVAC system. What goes to the maintenance team is not hundreds of pages of design documents, but the as-built drawings, equipment parameters, control logic and test records they actually need.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：ETOP 清單的實務價值
blocks.en: Key Point: The Practical Value of the ETOP List

blocks.zh: 本節列出的 17 項 ETOP 典型文件是一份極好的檢查清單。實務上建議：
blocks.en: The 17 typical ETOP documents listed in this section make an excellent checklist. In practice, we suggest:

blocks.zh: AHU 分區圖：維護時最常用——哪台 AHU 服務哪些區域？停機影響範圍多大？
blocks.en: AHU zoning drawing: the most frequently used during maintenance. Which AHU serves which areas? How large is the impact area when it is shut down?

blocks.zh: 風量平衡（Air Balance）：系統微調或故障排除的基準線
blocks.en: Air balance: the baseline for system fine-tuning or troubleshooting

blocks.zh: 控制圖：BMS 程式邏輯的物理呈現，是故障診斷的起點
blocks.en: Control drawings: the physical representation of the BMS program logic and the starting point for fault diagnosis

blocks.zh: 壓差/氣流方向圖：日常巡檢的參考依據
blocks.en: Differential pressure/airflow direction drawing: the reference for routine rounds

blocks.zh: 特別注意：ISPE 提到這些文件「may have no GMP impact」用於實驗室、OSD、包裝、API 等區域。但在無菌製造區域，同樣的文件可能就具有 GMP 關鍵性。
blocks.en: Note in particular: ISPE says these documents "may have no GMP impact" for laboratory, OSD, packaging and API areas. In aseptic manufacturing areas, however, the same documents may be GMP-critical.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：CDMO 的 ETOP 管理策略
blocks.en: Practical Application: ETOP Management Strategy for a CDMO

blocks.zh: CDMO 的挑戰在於同時服務多個客戶，每個客戶可能對 HVAC 文件有不同要求。建議：
blocks.en: The challenge for a CDMO is serving multiple clients at once, each of whom may have different requirements for HVAC documents. We suggest:

blocks.zh: 建立標準 ETOP 模板：所有新專案統一使用，確保一致性
blocks.en: Build a standard ETOP template: use it for all new projects to ensure consistency

blocks.zh: 電子化管理：將 ETOP 文件納入文件管理系統，方便客戶稽查時快速調閱
blocks.en: Manage electronically: put the ETOP documents in the document management system so they can be retrieved quickly during client audits

blocks.zh: 定期審查：每年至少一次確認 ETOP 內容是否仍然反映系統現狀
blocks.en: Review periodically: confirm at least once a year that the ETOP content still reflects the current state of the system

blocks.zh: 如果 ETOP 中的風量平衡數據與系統實際運行狀態不符（因為後來做了變更但沒更新文件），可能造成什麼後果？
blocks.en: If the air balance data in the ETOP does not match the actual operating state of the system (because a change was made later but the document was not updated), what consequences might follow?

blocks.zh: 本節提到 ETOP 比「完整的設計施工文件」對維護更有用。為什麼「更精簡」反而「更有價值」？請從維護人員的工作場景分析。
blocks.en: This section notes that the ETOP is more useful for maintenance than the "complete design and construction documents". Why is "leaner" actually "more valuable"? Analyze this from the maintenance technician's working scenario.

blocks.zh: 6.4 Master/Record Documents 6.4 主文件/紀錄文件
blocks.en: 6.4 Master/Record Documents

blocks.zh: 核心概念：主文件的範疇
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Scope of Master Documents

blocks.zh: Master Document（主文件）是「活的文件」——它不是施工結束就封存的歷史記錄，而是持續反映系統當前狀態的參考文件。
blocks.en: A Master Document is a "living document": not a historical record sealed away when construction ends, but a reference document that continuously reflects the current state of the system.

blocks.zh: 與 ETOP 的差異在於：ETOP 是一次性移交的文件包，而主文件必須隨著系統變更而持續更新。
blocks.en: The difference from the ETOP is that the ETOP is a one-time handover package, whereas master documents must be continuously updated as the system changes.

blocks.zh: 本節列出的 9 項文件，每一項都對應著維護和設施工程的核心需求：
blocks.en: Each of the 9 documents listed in this section corresponds to a core need of maintenance and facility engineering:

blocks.zh: AF&ID：系統「全貌圖」，最重要的主文件
blocks.en: AF&ID: the "big picture" of the system and the most important master document

blocks.zh: 序列操作（Sequence of Operation）：記錄 HVAC 系統的控制邏輯，如啟動/停機順序、連鎖條件
blocks.en: Sequence of Operation: records the control logic of the HVAC system, such as start-up/shutdown sequences and interlock conditions

blocks.zh: 過濾器測試數據：HEPA 完整性測試記錄，直接影響環境分級
blocks.en: Filter test data: HEPA integrity test records, which directly affect the area classification

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：主文件如同病歷
blocks.en: Analogy: A Master Document Is Like a Medical Record

blocks.zh: 主文件就像一個人的病歷——它不是出生時寫一次就永遠不變，而是每次就醫都會更新。血壓、體重、用藥記錄都要持續反映最新狀態。
blocks.en: A master document is like a person's medical record: it is not written once at birth and left unchanged, but updated at every visit. Blood pressure, weight and medication records all need to reflect the latest status.

blocks.zh: 如果醫生看到的是五年前的病歷，就無法做出正確的診斷。同理，如果維護工程師拿到的 AF&ID 還是三年前的版本，在故障排除時就可能做出錯誤判斷。
blocks.en: If the doctor sees a medical record from five years ago, a correct diagnosis is impossible. Likewise, if the maintenance engineer is holding an AF&ID that is still the version from three years ago, he or she may make the wrong judgment during troubleshooting.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：變更管理與主文件同步
blocks.en: Key Point: Change Management and Master Document Synchronization

blocks.zh: 主文件維護的最大挑戰是變更管理的執行力。每次 HVAC 系統有變更（新增過濾器、修改風量、調整壓差設定），都必須同步更新相關的主文件。
blocks.en: The biggest challenge in maintaining master documents is the execution of change management. Every time the HVAC system changes (adding a filter, modifying airflow, adjusting a differential pressure setpoint), the related master documents must be updated at the same time.

blocks.zh: 常見的失敗模式：工程變更已經完成、確效已經簽核，但 AF&ID 還停留在變更前的版本。這在 FDA 稽查中是高頻缺失項目。
blocks.en: A common failure mode: the engineering change has been completed and the qualification signed off, but the AF&ID is still at the pre-change version. This is a frequent deficiency in FDA inspections.

blocks.zh: 比較 6.3 節的 ETOP 清單和 6.4 節的主文件清單，哪些文件出現在兩份清單中？為什麼這些文件需要同時存在於兩個體系？
blocks.en: Compare the ETOP list in Section 6.3 with the master document list in Section 6.4. Which documents appear on both lists? Why do these documents need to exist in both systems?

blocks.zh: 「sequence of operation」（操作序列）為什麼是主文件？如果控制邏輯變更了但操作序列文件沒有更新，可能造成什麼風險？
blocks.en: Why is the "sequence of operation" a master document? If the control logic changes but the sequence of operation document is not updated, what risks might result?

blocks.zh: 6.5 GMP HVAC Documents 6.5 GMP 暖通空調文件
blocks.en: 6.5 GMP HVAC Documents

blocks.zh: 核心概念：風險評估驅動的文件分類
blocks.en: Core Concept: Risk-Assessment-Driven Document Classification

blocks.zh: 本節是整章最重要的轉折——從「工程文件」進入「GMP 文件」領域。
blocks.en: This section is the most important turning point of the chapter, moving from "engineering documents" into the realm of "GMP documents".

blocks.zh: ISPE 的核心邏輯是：哪些 HVAC 文件需要成為 GMP 文件，不是由固定清單決定，而是由風險評估（Risk Assessment）驅動。
blocks.en: ISPE's core logic is: which HVAC documents need to become GMP documents is not decided by a fixed list but driven by risk assessment.

blocks.zh: 這意味著同樣一份 AHU 分區圖，在 OSD 廠房可能只是 ETOP 文件，但在無菌充填區就是 Critical Master Document。差異取決於該系統對產品品質的風險影響程度。
blocks.en: This means that the same AHU zoning drawing may be only an ETOP document in an OSD facility but a Critical Master Document in an aseptic filling area. The difference depends on the risk the system poses to product quality.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Decision Hierarchy 在文件管理中的體現
blocks.en: Key Point: The Decision Hierarchy in Document Management

blocks.zh: 回到 ISPE 的決策層級：
blocks.en: Returning to ISPE's decision hierarchy:

blocks.zh: 無菌保證（Sterility Assurance）：直接影響無菌保證的 HVAC 文件（如 Grade A/B 區域的環境分級圖、HEPA 測試記錄）必須是 Critical Master Document
blocks.en: Sterility Assurance: HVAC documents that directly affect sterility assurance (such as the area classification drawing for Grade A/B areas and HEPA test records) must be Critical Master Documents

blocks.zh: 產品 CQA：影響產品品質屬性的 HVAC 參數文件（如溫濕度記錄）需要 GMP 管控
blocks.en: Product CQAs: HVAC parameter documents that affect product quality attributes (such as temperature and humidity records) require GMP control

blocks.zh: 營運彈性：僅影響營運效率的文件（如非分級區域的 AHU 圖）可以是非 GMP 文件
blocks.en: Operational flexibility: documents that affect only operating efficiency (such as AHU drawings for unclassified areas) can be non-GMP documents

blocks.zh: 6.5.1 Commissioning and Qualification Documents 6.5.1 試車與確效文件
blocks.en: 6.5.1 Commissioning and Qualification Documents

blocks.zh: 核心概念：C&Q 文件的兩個類別
blocks.en: Core Concept: Two Categories of C&Q Documents

blocks.zh: 本節將試車確效（C&Q）文件分為兩大類：
blocks.en: This section divides commissioning and qualification (C&Q) documents into two major categories:

blocks.zh: 被「槓桿」進 C&Q 的文件（leveraged into）：這些文件原本是工程/設計文件，現在被納入確效體系作為證據。例如 AF&ID、環境條件表等。
blocks.en: Documents "leveraged into" C&Q: these were originally engineering/design documents and are now brought into the qualification system as evidence. Examples include the AF&ID and the environmental condition tables.

blocks.zh: 在 C&Q 過程中「產生」的文件（produced during）：這些文件是測試活動的直接產出，如氣流可視化測試、微粒計數等。
blocks.en: Documents "produced during" C&Q: these are the direct outputs of test activities, such as airflow visualization and particle counts.

blocks.zh: 「槓桿」（leverage）這個詞是 ISPE 的用語特色——意思是不需要重做測試，直接引用已有的工程數據作為確效證據。這是「不重複測試」原則的具體體現。
blocks.en: "Leverage" is a characteristic ISPE term. It means existing engineering data can be cited directly as qualification evidence without repeating the tests. This is a concrete expression of the "do not repeat testing" principle.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：考試的「免試入學」vs.「參加考試」
blocks.en: Analogy: "Exemption from the Exam" vs. "Taking the Exam"

blocks.zh: Leveraged documents 就像「免試入學」——你在施工階段已經做過的測試（如 HEPA 完整性測試），不需要在確效階段再做一次，直接引用結果。
blocks.en: Leveraged documents are like "admission without an exam": tests you already performed during construction (such as the HEPA integrity test) do not need to be performed again in the qualification phase; you simply cite the results.

blocks.zh: Produced documents 就像「參加考試」——氣流可視化、微生物測試等，必須在確效階段（或製程驗證階段）才能執行，因為需要在「接近實際運行」的狀態下測試。
blocks.en: Produced documents are like "taking the exam": airflow visualization, microbiological testing and so on can only be performed in the qualification phase (or the process validation phase), because they must be tested in a state "close to actual operation".

blocks.zh: 重點提示：試車文件清單中的關鍵細節
blocks.en: Key Point: Key Details in the Commissioning Document List

blocks.zh: 濕度「if deemed critical」：ISPE 特別標註濕度測試是「如果被判定為關鍵」。這意味著不是每個專案都必須做濕度確效——取決於產品對濕度的敏感性（如吸濕性粉末）。
blocks.en: Humidity "if deemed critical": ISPE specifically notes that humidity testing applies "if deemed critical". This means not every project needs humidity qualification; it depends on the product's sensitivity to humidity (such as hygroscopic powders).

blocks.zh: Alarm delay verification：不只測試警報功能，還要驗證警報延遲時間。過短會造成假警報，過長則喪失保護意義。
blocks.en: Alarm delay verification: do not only test the alarm function, but also verify the alarm delay time. Too short a delay causes false alarms; too long a delay defeats the purpose of the protection.

blocks.zh: Grade A vs. Grade B 的測試差異：Grade A（層流區）需要做面風速測試和氣流可視化；Grade B（背景環境）主要測試換氣次數和壓差。
blocks.en: Differences in testing between Grade A and Grade B: Grade A (unidirectional airflow zone) requires face velocity testing and airflow visualization; Grade B (background environment) is tested mainly for air change rate and differential pressure.

blocks.zh: Particle counts "at rest"：靜態微粒計數在試車階段進行；動態微粒計數（in operation）則在製程驗證階段執行。
blocks.en: Particle counts "at rest": at-rest particle counts are performed in the commissioning phase; dynamic particle counts (in operation) are performed in the process validation phase.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：CDMO 的 C&Q 文件策略
blocks.en: Practical Application: C&Q Document Strategy for a CDMO

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，C&Q 文件的品質直接影響客戶稽查結果和法規申報速度：
blocks.en: For a CDMO, the quality of C&Q documents directly affects client audit outcomes and the speed of regulatory filings:

blocks.zh: 建立 C&Q 文件模板庫：標準化每個測試的方案格式和允收標準
blocks.en: Build a C&Q document template library: standardize the protocol format and acceptance criteria for each test

blocks.zh: 善用 Leverage 原則：FAT 在設備供應商端完成的測試數據，可直接引用為 IQ 證據，節省到場測試時間
blocks.en: Make good use of the leverage principle: test data from the FAT completed at the equipment supplier's site can be cited directly as IQ evidence, saving on-site testing time

blocks.zh: 「at rest」vs.「in operation」的時序規劃：將靜態測試安排在試車階段，動態測試安排在製程驗證階段，避免排程衝突
blocks.en: Sequencing "at rest" vs. "in operation": schedule static tests in the commissioning phase and dynamic tests in the process validation phase to avoid scheduling conflicts

blocks.zh: 警報延遲驗證：與 BMS/SCADA 供應商在 FAT 階段就完成，避免到場後反覆調整
blocks.en: Alarm delay verification: complete it with the BMS/SCADA supplier at the FAT stage to avoid repeated adjustments on site

blocks.zh: 本節列出了「leveraged into」和「produced during」兩類文件。如果你在製程驗證階段才發現某項測試在試車階段被遺漏了，應該如何處理？重新做測試算是 Commissioning 還是 Qualification？
blocks.en: This section lists two categories of documents, "leveraged into" and "produced during". If you discover in the process validation phase that a test was missed in the commissioning phase, how should you handle it? Would repeating the test count as Commissioning or Qualification?

blocks.zh: 為什麼「airflow visualization」不能在靜態（at rest）階段完成，而必須在「in use」狀態下執行？請從污染控制的角度解釋。
blocks.en: Why can "airflow visualization" not be completed in the at-rest state, and instead must be performed in the "in use" state? Explain from a contamination control perspective.

blocks.zh: 某 CDMO 的新建無菌充填區使用 RABS 技術。請列出該區域 HVAC C&Q 至少需要哪 8 項關鍵測試文件。
blocks.en: A new aseptic filling area at a CDMO uses RABS technology. List at least 8 key test documents required for HVAC C&Q in this area.

blocks.zh: 6.5.2 Critical Master Documents 6.5.2 關鍵主文件
blocks.en: 6.5.2 Critical Master Documents

blocks.zh: 核心概念：關鍵主文件的法規意義
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Regulatory Significance of Critical Master Documents

blocks.zh: Critical Master Document（關鍵主文件）是 HVAC 文件體系中層級最高的文件類別。它有兩個關鍵特徵：
blocks.en: A Critical Master Document is the highest-level category in the HVAC document system. It has two key characteristics:

blocks.zh: 提供 CMC 申報資訊：藥品上市申請中，CMC 部分需要描述製造環境條件。HVAC 的關鍵主文件就是這些描述的數據來源。
blocks.en: It provides information for CMC filings: in a marketing application, the CMC section must describe the manufacturing environment conditions. The HVAC critical master documents are the data source for these descriptions.

blocks.zh: 受法規審查：FDA、EMA 等法規機構有權要求查看這些文件，且期望它們永遠反映系統的當前狀態。
blocks.en: It is subject to regulatory review: regulators such as the FDA and EMA have the right to ask to see these documents and expect them to always reflect the current state of the system.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：關鍵主文件 vs. C&Q 文件的比較
blocks.en: Key Point: Critical Master Documents vs. C&Q Documents

blocks.zh: 比較 6.5.1 和 6.5.2 的清單，會發現兩者高度重疊但有重要差異：
blocks.en: Comparing the lists in 6.5.1 and 6.5.2, you will find that they overlap heavily but differ in important ways:

blocks.zh: 新增項目：Risk assessments 和 Traceability matrix——這兩項在 C&Q 文件清單中未出現，但在關鍵主文件中必須包含。原因是稽查員需要看到「為什麼選擇這些測試項目」的邏輯依據。
blocks.en: Added items: Risk assessments and the Traceability matrix. These two do not appear in the C&Q document list but must be included in the critical master documents. The reason is that inspectors need to see the rationale for "why these test items were chosen".

blocks.zh: 壓差記錄方式的疑問：「continuous logging for classified spaces or spot-check?」——ISPE 刻意用問號，表示這取決於風險評估。對無菌區域，連續記錄（continuous logging）通常是必要的；對非無菌分級區域，定期抽查（spot-check）可能就足夠。
blocks.en: The question on pressure differential recording: "continuous logging for classified spaces or spot-check?" ISPE deliberately uses a question mark to show that this depends on the risk assessment. For aseptic areas, continuous logging is usually necessary; for non-aseptic classified areas, periodic spot-checks may be sufficient.

blocks.zh: 移除項目：溫濕度 mapping、倉庫相關測試等不在此清單中——因為這些通常不屬於「關鍵」範疇。
blocks.en: Removed items: temperature and humidity mapping, warehouse-related tests and so on are not in this list, because they usually do not fall within the "critical" scope.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：關鍵主文件如同公司營業執照
blocks.en: Analogy: A Critical Master Document Is Like a Company's Business License

blocks.zh: 關鍵主文件的地位，就像企業的營業執照和重要合約——不是放在抽屜裡偶爾拿出來的東西，而是隨時可能被政府機關要求查看的文件。
blocks.en: A critical master document has the status of a company's business license or key contracts: not something kept in a drawer and taken out occasionally, but a document that the authorities may ask to see at any time.

blocks.zh: 如果營業執照上的地址已經搬遷但沒有更新，會怎樣？被罰款、被質疑誠信。HVAC 的關鍵主文件也是同理——如果稽查員發現 AF&ID 上的設備配置與現場不符，後果可能是 FDA 483 觀察項甚至 Warning Letter。
blocks.en: What happens if the address on the business license has changed but the license was not updated? You are fined and your integrity is questioned. The same is true of HVAC critical master documents. If an inspector finds that the equipment configuration on the AF&ID does not match the site, the consequence may be an FDA 483 observation or even a Warning Letter.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：良好文件管理規範（GDocP）在關鍵主文件中的應用
blocks.en: Practical Application: Good Documentation Practice (GDocP) for Critical Master Documents

blocks.zh: GDocP（Good Documentation Practice，良好文件管理規範）對關鍵主文件有特別嚴格的要求：
blocks.en: GDocP (Good Documentation Practice) sets especially strict requirements for critical master documents:

blocks.zh: 版本控制：每次修訂必須有版本號、修訂日期、修訂原因、審批簽名
blocks.en: Version control: every revision must carry a version number, revision date, reason for revision and approval signatures

blocks.zh: 變更追蹤：所有變更必須通過正式的變更控制程序（Change Control）
blocks.en: Change tracking: all changes must go through the formal change control procedure

blocks.zh: 定期審查：建議每年至少審查一次，確認文件內容是否仍然反映系統現狀
blocks.en: Periodic review: we recommend a review at least once a year to confirm that the content still reflects the current state of the system

blocks.zh: 備份與歸檔：紙本和電子版都需要安全保管，符合數據完整性（Data Integrity）要求
blocks.en: Backup and archiving: both paper and electronic versions must be stored securely and meet Data Integrity requirements

blocks.zh: 如果 FDA 稽查員要求查看你的 HVAC 關鍵主文件，你能在多少時間內提供？如果不能在 24 小時內提供最新版本，這反映了什麼問題？
blocks.en: If an FDA inspector asks to see your HVAC critical master documents, how quickly can you provide them? If you cannot provide the latest version within 24 hours, what does that reveal about your system?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 Risk Assessment 和 Traceability Matrix 只出現在「關鍵主文件」清單而不在「C&Q 文件」清單中？這兩份文件在法規稽查中扮演什麼角色？
blocks.en: Why do the Risk Assessment and the Traceability Matrix appear only on the "Critical Master Documents" list and not on the "C&Q documents" list? What role do these two documents play in regulatory inspections?

blocks.zh: 「continuous logging or spot-check?」這個問題的答案取決於什麼因素？請為一個 CDMO 的無菌充填區設計你的壓差監控策略，並說明理由。
blocks.en: What factors determine the answer to "continuous logging or spot-check?" Design your differential pressure monitoring strategy for a CDMO aseptic filling area and explain your reasons.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 文件生命週期規劃要趁早：在概念設計階段就決定每份 HVAC 文件的最終歸宿（ETOP / 主文件 / 關鍵主文件），不要等到確效完成才分類
blocks.en: Plan the document life cycle early: decide the final destination of each HVAC document (ETOP / Master Document / Critical Master Document) at the conceptual design stage; do not wait until qualification is complete to classify them

blocks.zh: 竣工圖（As-built）是基礎：所有 HVAC 文件管理的起點是將設計圖更新為竣工狀態，反映實際安裝配置。AF&ID、區域分級圖和壓差圖是最低限度必須保持最新的文件
blocks.en: As-built drawings are the foundation: the starting point of all HVAC document management is updating design drawings to as-built status to reflect the actual installed configuration. The AF&ID, area classification drawing and pressure differential drawing are the minimum set that must be kept current

blocks.zh: ETOP 精簡但完整：工程移交文件包的設計原則是「給維護團隊他們真正需要的」，而非「把所有文件都丟過去」
blocks.en: The ETOP is lean but complete: the design principle of the engineering turnover package is "give the maintenance team what they really need", not "throw all the documents at them"

blocks.zh: 主文件是「活的」：Master Document 必須隨系統變更持續更新，而 Critical Master Document 更必須隨時保持在可接受稽查的狀態
blocks.en: Master documents are "living": a Master Document must be continuously updated as the system changes, and a Critical Master Document must be kept in a constant state of inspection readiness

blocks.zh: 風險評估驅動 GMP 文件分類：哪些文件需要成為 GMP 文件，取決於設計階段的風險評估結果，而非一成不變的清單
blocks.en: Risk assessment drives GMP document classification: which documents must become GMP documents depends on the results of the design-phase risk assessment, not on a fixed list

blocks.zh: C&Q 文件的「槓桿」原則：善用 leverage 概念，將施工階段已完成的測試數據直接引用為確效證據，避免重複測試
blocks.en: The "leverage" principle for C&Q documents: make good use of the leverage concept by citing test data already completed during construction directly as qualification evidence, avoiding repeated testing

blocks.zh: 關鍵主文件是最高層級：提供 CMC 申報資訊、受法規審查、包含風險評估和追溯矩陣，必須符合 GDocP（良好文件管理規範）的嚴格要求
blocks.en: Critical Master Documents are the highest level: they provide information for CMC filings, are subject to regulatory review, include the risk assessment and traceability matrix, and must meet the strict requirements of GDocP (Good Documentation Practice)
